# Feature Implementation Skill

## Objective

Implement the approved technical design in the existing
production codebase.

## Instructions

1. Read and understand the approved technical design.
2. Explore existing code before making changes.
3. Identify reusable services and components.
4. Implement the requested functionality.
5. Follow existing architecture and coding conventions.
6. Add appropriate logging and error handling.
7. Implement unit tests.
8. Add integration tests where applicable.
9. Run relevant builds and test suites.
10. Review the complete git diff.

## Engineering Rules

- Do not redesign architecture without approval.
- Do not introduce unnecessary dependencies.
- Do not modify unrelated modules.
- Maintain backward compatibility.
- Do not hardcode secrets.
- Do not remove existing tests to make builds pass.

## Expected Output

### 1. Implementation Summary
### 2. Files Changed
### 3. Design Decisions
### 4. Tests Added
### 5. Build and Test Results
### 6. Known Limitations
